domain: open axis: net-share-issuance financing-flow family on the death-inclusive cohort, built from a second staged-panel field family (equity-stub share-count vintages: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding / dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding / us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued, each row carrying evidenced eff/avail vintage stamps in the hash-pinned multi-vintage panel). The EODHD price leg is used only for eligibility, band assignment, fills, exits and benchmark context; no price-, volume- or return-derived observable enters any exposure; no fundamentals LEVEL enters any exposure; no revision direction/severity and no timing-lag observable is cited.
title: Supply absorption and managerial market timing: long/short the log growth of evidenced shares-outstanding vintages (net issuance short, net repurchase long), market-neutral, on the death-inclusive cohort

mechanism.who_is_the_constrained_or_mispriced_acto: Three actors, one per face of the exposure. (1) The marginal holder of small- and micro-cap equity: mandate- and liquidity-constrained demand whose curve slopes down, so net-new share supply must be absorbed over weeks by progressively weaker valuations (Scholes 1972 supply functions; Shleifer 1986; the Duffie gradual-movement friction). The issuer does not choose this absorption path and the buyer does not coordinate around it. (2) The issuing manager: the financing decision is low-salience insider information - issuance clusters where managers' own perceived valuation is rich (Baker-Wurgler 2000) and repurchase where it is cheap, and the decision leaks through cover-page/footnote XBRL share-count tags that carry no headline, so the attention it receives is thin (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003 limited attention to low-salience disclosures). (3) At the cohort's distressed and dying tail, an issuance that dilutes existing equity holders to service creditors is a debt-holder/equity-holder transfer that screens built on per-share aggregates systematically miss; the equity side of that conflict is slow to reprice because the transfer is only visible by comparing successive evidenced share counts.
mechanism.why_the_mispricing_persists: Limits to arbitrage are structural here: fading issuance requires shorting recently-issuing small caps (hard-to-borrow, recall and buy-in risk) while absorbing the repurchase side with patient capital; institutional mandates penalize the concentrated small-cap short book that the trade requires; and roughly three quarters of the tradable cohort (1,397 of 1,758 covered priced names are DEAD_EVIDENCED) sits outside every benchmark product, index and analyst screen - the least-arbitraged corner of the listed universe. The signal source is also low-salience by construction: a share count is nobody's headline number, it arrives inside documents the market reads for other reasons, and PIT-clean share-count histories for delisted names exist in essentially no commercially curated dataset - this cohort's evidenced vintage panel is the only place the mechanism can even be measured at the dead tail.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: For entity i at decision t: V_last = the latest evidenced value of the entity's primary share-count field whose first_avail stamp is strictly before the decision-session start-of-day and within the 800-day staleness bound; V_prev = the value of the immediately preceding eff-period group of the same field (both stamps within the 800-day bound; else abstain). Exposure S_i(t) = ln(V_last / V_prev) - positive for net issuance, negative for net repurchase. Legs: long all eligible names with S_i < 0, short all with S_i > 0, equal weight within legs, 0.5 gross per leg. Names whose |S_i| exceeds ln(2) are excluded (frozen constant, see frozen_thresholds): without an authorized split series, the split/reverse-split mechanical tail is indistinguishable from issuance and is conservatively removed - counted and reported, never silently dropped.
mechanism.why_not_a_vetoed_form_in_new_words: The exposure is a FINANCING FLOW IN SHARE SPACE denominated by the name's own prior share count. It is not momentum/semivariance/vol-level (no return, variance or volume input anywhere); not WC-stock intensity (no working-capital item, no asset/sales denominator); not Goodwill/bloat (no goodwill or asset-growth object); not F1-accrual-flow (no income-vs-cash gap); not depletion-runway (no capex/depletion object and no interaction); not cash-level shadow (no cash or asset LEVEL anywhere - a flow ratio of two share counts, not a stock of resources); not sector-exposure form (no sector weighting in the exposure; sector enters only the benchmark reporting contract); not V10's deseasonalized-timing characteristic book (no timing-lag observable cited); not V10's revision-correction direction/breadth (no corrected filed VALUE enters - the share-count FIELD LEVELS are the object, and direction of a filing-value correction is never read). The nearest veto geometries are the growth-form shadows (WC-stock intensity, Goodwill/bloat) because all are balance-sheet change measures; the D2 rho on conditioning exposures adjudicates, and the declared binding risk is exactly there.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (a) if issuance is repriced within the first session, the next-session fill clock harvests nothing; (b) if the ln(2) exclusion is insufficient and split mechanics dominate the retained tail, expectancy is nonpositive and the neighbour's long-only leg reveals the asymmetry; (c) if the exposure merely proxies size/liquidity/cohort composition, the permutation control reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign expectancy or outrunning a negative anchor) and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule; (d) if the borrow-cost reality of shorting issuers exceeds the edge, base-cost expectancy fails first and the 2x stress rerun is decisively negative; (e) if share-count vintages are too sparse at the decision dates inside the folds, the frozen floors abstain fail-closed and the scored-decision count falls under the minimums - a legitimate INFEASIBLE verdict pre-declared here.

falsifiable_prediction: The net-issuance long/short book (gross 1.0, net approximately 0, one decision per 21-session grid step, 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER base band costs, position PF >= 1.10, >= 2 of 3 folds positive expectancy, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched SPY-excess expectancy > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, and |permutation-control expectancy| < 0.5 x |anchor expectancy| (same-sign) with the permutation control never outrunning a negative anchor. The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the permutation control matches or outruns the anchor including the negative-anchor case (frozen falsification-by-control rule); pooled novelty |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the ELEVEN veto entries at D2, measured on conditioning exposures; drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; reproduction is not ALL_MATCH. REJECT is a successful outcome; no gate is weakened to admit a thin margin (P-2 margins recorded, never traded away).

universe.legs: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) - the death-inclusive cohort frozen in p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json (carried payload). GAP_COVERAGE (513) and NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) excluded-with-reasons, recorded, never held.
universe.eligibility: at each decision session a name is eligible iff: (i) >= 63 bars through the decision session in its own series (history floor only); (ii) band C or better (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD; UNTRADABLE excluded at decision); (iii) RAW close >= 1.00 USD; (iv) a valid exposure: two evidenced vintages of the primary share-count field, both within the 800-day staleness bound, both strictly positive, with |S_i| <= ln(2), and the primary field chosen by the frozen priority rule (see frozen_thresholds).
universe.dead_name_semantics: preregistered: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on the final session (the delisting return is carried by the price series itself); fill-check enforced (a missing bar at the fill session means the order does not exist - no synthetic continuation, no substitute pricing); no post-series prices read, interpolated or synthesized; no survivorship re-substitution; no arm requires a price after any series' last bar. Lane pre-check (recorded for A9): 1,397 of the 1,758 priced entities with a valid consecutive share pair are DEAD_EVIDENCED - the dead tail is the population, not a residual.
universe.no_lookahead_in_class_labels: alive/dead attribution is computed only as post-hoc stratified REPORTING per fold; the exposure and eligibility never use survival class (not knowable at the decision).

sanctioned_clocks_cited.observable: arrival event (cik, first_avail) with post-arrival bookable window W bars

clock.citation_scope_honesty: the share-count fields conditioned here are filer-field substreams of the SAME vintage-availability machinery the P2 clock governs: a filer-event is the vintage-availability instant (cik, first_avail) of any filer-field-period group, and the share-count field groups' first_avail stamps are a subset of the 74,931 censused filer-events; no new clock is invented and none is available beyond the three funded tuples - the conditioning stream is the P2 panel artifact itself (sha256 67591464ee49acc159886143a379bda5890b1df602818b600d7938df92af1447, 10,073,069 rows).
clock.staleness: p2 clock_semantics.staleness_rule_declared_ex_ante, verbatim: 'every conditioning input uses max_age_days 800 (the V9/V10 funded-clock bound, carried unchanged); no unbounded variant'. Both vintages of every exposure pair carry stamps inside the bound or the name abstains fail-closed.
clock.no_contemporaneous_inputs: a share-count vintage conditions decision t iff its first_avail stamp is strictly earlier than the start-of-day UTC of the decision session (date-only stamps take the conservative-later bound: first session strictly after the stamp). The availability-lag mutation rule applies unchanged: pushing a vintage stamp later shifts the exposure update by exactly that amount and changes nothing else.
clock.deadline_distance: NOT cited: DATA_BLOCKED_VALID per p2_v11_coverage_first.json not_funded (P-1); any deadline claim is infeasible this cycle.
clock.no_revision_direction_no_timing_lag: no V10-R1/R2 direction/magnitude observable and no V10-T1/T2/T3 timing observable is cited, ranked or conditioned in any arm; the family is a second field family (equity-stub share counts), not a revision or timing form.

warmup_rationale: 3 grid steps = 63 sessions of price history for the ADV63 band assignment and the >= 63-bar eligibility floor; the exposure itself needs no expanding history beyond its two evidenced vintages, so no additional abstention is declared; the first grid decision of each fold may abstain fail-closed if the cohort scoreable floor (30) or a leg floor (5) is unmet.
decision_grid: 21-session grid carried unchanged from the V8/V9/V10 construction: per-fold local session indices 63 + 21k, strictly inside each fold, on the union session calendar (~27 decisions per fold expected; exact counts computed by A9 from the frozen calendar - structure only). Folds frozen per p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json carried payload: S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01, S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09, S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24. Books forced flat at every fold boundary with cost. Unused scored slots are never reassigned; max six scored cells cycle-wide (V11 budget 0/6).
entry_exit_fills: band-resolved house fills: signals computed from PIT stamps strictly before the decision session and bars through session t-1 (eligibility, ADV63 band); orders filled at the NEXT session, close-to-close, no same-session fill; fill-check: a name without a bar at the fill session simply does not fill (its order does not exist; legs are NOT renormalized - realized gross is reported); holding one decision to the next (21 sessions); force-flat with cost at fold boundaries; L-I3 fail-closed band resolution throughout (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py); dead-name exit at last recorded close per universe.dead_name_semantics, charged per resolve_exit_band_bps (C-rate ceiling when the exit band is unrateable).

costs.model: p3_v11_invariants_freeze.json carried payload, verbatim: 'band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side base, stress x2 applied to booked PnL; costs linear in fills; charged exactly once per fill'. Kernel: BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of(ADV63): >= 50,000,000 A, >= 10,000,000 B, >= 2,000,000 C, else UNTRADABLE; entries never use the UNTRADABLE path.
costs.application: costs linear in fills (|dw| x band bps x multiplier / 10,000), charged exactly once per fill per side, applied to BOOKED PnL; no sidecar, no accrual-by-stamp.
costs.resolution: L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError; the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; terminal/exit fills of names whose band has become UNTRADABLE or missing are charged the C-rate ceiling (25 bps base / 50 stress) per resolve_exit_band_bps - a computed conservative resolution, never a default.
costs.stress: stress tier = x2 multiplier on booked PnL (20/30/50 bps); gate: stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.0.

arms.spec: At each decision t: long all eligible names with S_i(t) < 0 (net repurchase), short all eligible names with S_i(t) > 0 (net issuance); equal weight within legs, 0.5 gross per leg, gross 1.0; abstain if either leg < 5 names (frozen floor) or the cohort scoreable floor (< 30 valid exposures) is unmet. No magnitude tilt, no sector conditioning, no price input of any kind in the ranking.

Long-only net-repurchase book: identical machinery and eligibility, long leg only (S_i < 0), gross 1.0, equal weight, same floors. Mechanism-support semantics declared ex-ante: supply absorption plus managerial timing predict the repurchase side carries a positive premium on its own; a long-only result with the same sign supports the mechanism, while an anchor that works ONLY through the short-issuance leg is declared elevated-risk evidence (short-side borrow/mechanics contamination at the distressed tail) and downweights the family regardless of the anchor's profitability. This arm also sidesteps the reverse-split-contaminated short tail entirely, which is why it is the neighbour rather than a magnitude tilt.

Deterministic within-decision permutation placebo (matched-null): at each scored decision, the anchor's exposure VALUES are permuted across that decision's eligible names using a frozen deterministic hash order (sha256 of the string cycle|{hypothesis_id}|{cik}|{decision_index}, hex-sorted - no RNG library, byte-reproducible). The permutation preserves the exact cross-sectional distribution of exposures, the exact eligibility set, and all fill/cost/dead-leg machinery, while destroying the name-to-flow link. RUNNABILITY by construction: it abstains exactly where the anchor abstains and can never abort on data semantics (forex V3 lesson). Refutation semantics: if the permuted book reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x same-sign expectancy, or outrunning the anchor including the negative-anchor case), the exposure was proxying size, liquidity or cohort composition rather than the issuance flow, and the family dies per the frozen falsification-by-control rule. This control knowingly walks into the cluster's gunsight; that is its purpose.

exposure_definition: Per entity i at decision t, for the D2 rank-correlation screen against each of the ELEVEN veto entries on the same decision x entity cohort: EXPOSURE_i(t) = S_i(t) = ln(V_last_i(t) / V_prev_i(t)), where V_last_i(t) is the latest evidenced value of i's primary share-count field with first_avail strictly before decision-session start-of-day and within the 800-day bound; V_prev_i(t) is the value of the immediately preceding eff-period group of the same field (its own stamp also within the 800-day bound); both strictly positive else the name is unscored at t. Primary field per entity = the priority-ordered field with the most period groups in the panel (ties broken by priority order us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding > dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding > us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued). Names with |S_i| > ln(2) are excluded (counted, reported). Ranking direction for D2: DESCENDING S (most net-issued = rank 1). Inputs are exactly the evidenced share-count vintage stamps and values of the pinned panel plus each stamp's own availability evidence; no price, volume, share-price, sector, revision-direction, timing-lag or fundamentals-level field enters the exposure. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho of this exposure vs each veto-entry exposure; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required, measured pre-selection, hedged relabellings die.

pre_selection_identifiability_check.anchor_vs_control_gate: pooled Spearman rho(anchor exposure vector, permutation-control exposure vector) <= 0.10, measured BEFORE selection from the PIT panel only (the permutation is exposure-space arithmetic; no outcome file exists or is needed). By construction the permuted vector is a relabelling of the anchor's values across names, so the gate measures that the control's conditioning geometry is decorrelated from the anchor's name assignment; a measured rho > 0.10 means the permutation was not executed as declared - a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.non_vacuity_gates: measured from PIT panel + price availability only: (i) >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold with the frozen floors (leg >= 5 names, cohort >= 30 valid exposures); (ii) lane pre-check recorded here for A9 to re-verify, not to assume: 138,719 share-count vintage rows in the fold window (avail >= 2018-04-04) across the priority fields; 1,758 priced tradable-cohort entities (361 ALIVE_EVIDENCED + 1,397 DEAD_EVIDENCED; 18 NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE additionally, excluded by universe) carry >= 2 period vintages with a strictly-positive consecutive pair; price store re-verified 2,168 CIK__TICKER files this lane.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.control_can_refute: the permutation control can refute the mechanism because it deletes exactly the name-to-flow association while holding everything else fixed; if the family's expectancy survives the deletion, the priced object is not the issuance flow. Its verdict binds under the data semantics it was computed with (P-3) and recomputes under any semantics change.

incremental_alpha_test: per the frozen factor_and_benchmark contract carried from V8/V9/V10: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross rule), per fold and overall; gate: overall SPY-excess expectancy > 0 and >= 2 of 3 folds positive; secondary equal-weight 11-SPDR sector-ETF factor reported per fold (reported, not gated - no sector weighting exists in the book to gate). ETF-share gate <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist: this family has NO ETF legs in any arm - declared NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante; SPY-excess positivity is declared and gates as stated. The book is approximately net-neutral by construction, so the alpha gate binds on mechanism absence, not beta dressing - that is the honest crucible.
turnover_and_sample_floor: >= 30 scored decisions overall and >= 5 per fold (binding minimum; expected ~27/fold x 3 folds on the 21-session grid, A9-verified). Per-decision one-way turnover from the 21-session holding is structurally ~1x gross per decision plus exits; every fill is charged exactly once per the cost contract; dead-leg exits add fills at death and are charged at the C-ceiling resolution. If floors abstain the family under count, the verdict is INFEASIBLE (declared in margin_to_fail), never a silently reduced book.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution name; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. (2) drop-one-fold: expectancy recomputed with each fold removed; survival iff min over folds > 0. (3) drop-one-field: rerun with each of the three priority fields excluded in turn as primary (field-priority sensitivity of the coverage rule, not a parameter search - all three reruns are declared here, no others exist). All reruns inherit identical eligibility, bands, fills, costs and dead-name semantics.

margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: coin-flip ex ante; the issuance anomaly must clear an expected band-B/C-weighted cost of roughly 15-25 bps/side on a 21-session hold; if it fails, expect a small negative (order 1e-4/decision).
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.10: expected binding if the mechanism is real; margin expected thin (< 0.1) per P-2 knife-edge doctrine.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_of_3: MEDIUM-HIGH RISK: issuance waves cluster in calendar time (equity-issue waves are regime episodes), so one fold may carry the whole effect; declared as the most likely structural failure.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: MEDIUM RISK: net-neutral construction helps, but a one-sided issuance wave (a sector-period buyback or SEO episode) can skew net exposure within a fold.
margin_to_fail_expectations.spy_excess_positivity: MEDIUM RISK for a neutral book: passes only if the flow is cohort-specific rather than factor-timed.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_share_le_0.50: NOT_APPLICABLE ex-ante (no ETF legs in any arm); declared here so the gate's non-binding status is a preregistered fact, not a discovered one.
margin_to_fail_expectations.permutation_control_ratio_lt_0.5: HIGH RISK and pre-committed: size/liquidity composition and the issuance flow are correlated in this cohort (issuers skew larger and more liquid), so the permutation control retaining part of the anchor is the honest expectation; the family survives only if the flow adds information beyond composition. If the control reproduces the anchor, accept falsification without argument (V4/V9/V10 precedent).
margin_to_fail_expectations.stress_2x: HIGH RISK if base-cost margin is thin (P-2 knife-edge doctrine).
margin_to_fail_expectations.scored_decision_floors: LOW-MEDIUM RISK: lane pre-check measured 1,758 priced covered entities and 138,719 fold-window vintages, so sparsity abstention is unlikely but declared fail-safe (abstain, then INFEASIBLE if under count) rather than assumed away.
margin_to_fail_expectations.novelty_rho_le_0.20: the BINDING measurement risk of this proposal: the nearest veto geometries are the growth-form shadows (WC-stock intensity, Goodwill/bloat) and cash-level, because issuance co-moves with balance-sheet growth and with raised cash. The geometry differs (own-share-denominated financing flow, split tail excluded, no asset/sales/WC/cash item anywhere), and D2 measures rather than argues; a |rho| > 0.20 vs any entry kills the family at D2 and that is an acceptable outcome.
margin_to_fail_expectations.reproduction_ALL_MATCH: required; process gate, no economic expectation.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_and_control_negative: share-count financing flows carry no tradable information at these costs; REJECT with margin-to-fail per gate (P-2).
failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_control_positive_or_repr: falsification-by-control fires: the priced object is size/liquidity/composition, not the issuance flow; recorded, never rescued (falsification-by-control cluster instance).
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_but_control_reproduces: same as above - the flow added nothing beyond composition; REJECT; a profitable-but-unmechanistic book is not a survivor under the frozen rule.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_alpha_negative: factor-timed issuance waves, not mechanism; REJECT.
failure_interpretation.only_one_fold_positive: issuing-wave artifact of a single calendar episode; not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.neighbour_only: if only the long-only buyback neighbour works and the anchor's short leg is decisive-negative, the anchor is declared borrow/mechanics-contaminated at the distressed tail; the family is REJECTED this cycle with the asymmetry recorded as an observation, not promoted as a rescue variant.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_gates: proceed to Stage-A with the preregistered parameters only; no re-tuning; margin-to-fail reported per gate.

frozen_thresholds.field_priority: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding > dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding > us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued, tie-broken by period-group count then priority order - a declared evidence-quality ordering (balance-sheet audited count > cover-page dei count > issued count, which ignores treasury retirement), frozen ex-ante, no alternative ordering exists in any arm.
frozen_thresholds.split_tail_exclusion_ln2: |S| > ln(2) excluded: a declared structural constant, not a tuned filter - without an authorized split series, one-period share-count growth beyond +100% (or contraction beyond -50%) is mechanically dominated by splits/reverse splits in this cohort; the rule removes the contaminated tail conservatively, counts exclusions, and reports them. Rationale-first, single constant, no grid.
frozen_thresholds.staleness_800d: both vintages of every pair inside the 800-day bound (P2 verbatim rule).
frozen_thresholds.window_21_sessions: one grid period; issuance absorption is documented over weeks-to-quarters and the holding equals one grid step - the same construction the program's accounting contract is priced for; not re-tuned anywhere.
frozen_thresholds.cohort_scoreable_floor_30: mirrors the frozen min_hist_cohort = 30 convention of the P0 observable layer.
frozen_thresholds.leg_floor_5_names: inherited accounting minimum (>= 1 non-CASH leg per scored decision with meaningful equal-weight dispersion).
frozen_thresholds.gross_1.0_half_per_leg: cross-sectional mechanism expressed market-neutral; beta dressing is the confound this design must not enter.

no_parameter_grid_declaration: one field priority, one exclusion constant, one staleness bound, one holding window, one floor per concept - all frozen above with stated rationale; no grid search over windows, exclusions, terciles, universes, top-K, field orderings or costs anywhere in any arm; the neighbour changes exactly one thing (long leg only) and the control changes exactly one thing (name assignment), both declared; drop-one reruns are declared diagnostics with no admission path back into the family parameters.

could_be_confused_with.momentum_incl_V2_ETF_relative: no return, price or volume input anywhere in the exposure; share-count growth is a filing-vintage object - expected rho near zero; measured at D2.
could_be_confused_with.semivariance: no downside/variance object exists in the family; PASS.
could_be_confused_with.WC_stock_intensity: the nearest veto form: both are balance-sheet change measures. Concrete design difference: no working-capital item and no asset/sales denominator exist here - the flow is in SHARE space (own prior share count as denominator) and the split tail is excluded; the D2 rho on conditioning exposures adjudicates and this entry is the declared binding risk.
could_be_confused_with.Goodwill_bloat: same growth-form family risk as WC; concrete difference: no goodwill or asset-growth object; share-space flow; measured at D2.
could_be_confused_with.F1_accrual_flow: no income-vs-cash item; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.depletion_runway_interaction: no capex, depletion or runway object; PASS by construction.
could_be_confused_with.cash_level_shadow: second-nearest veto form: issuers raise cash. Concrete difference: the exposure contains no cash or asset LEVEL - only two share counts; the cash stock is never read; measured at D2 and declared as binding risk alongside WC.
could_be_confused_with.sector_exposure_form: no sector weighting anywhere in the exposure; sector enters only benchmark reporting (secondary, reported not gated); PASS.
could_be_confused_with.V10_deseasonalized_timing_characteristic: no timing-lag observable cited or conditioned; the family never reads first_avail AS A SIGNAL (it is the availability evidence every sanctioned clock already carries); PASS.
could_be_confused_with.V10_revision_correction_direction_breadt: no corrected filed VALUE, no revision direction/severity/breadth observable enters any arm; share-count FIELD LEVELS are the object; PASS.

novelty_declaration.vs_prior_stocks_families: no prior stocks family conditioned on share-count financing flows (the field family was never cited before V11; the eleven-entry veto set contains no share-count form); the lane's field census (138,719 fold-window share-count vintages) is the first coverage statement for this family in the program.
novelty_declaration.vs_axis_1_lane: no event-window or drift form exists here; the V11-E1 clock is cited for its vintage-availability semantics (what is knowable when), not for any event book.
novelty_declaration.vs_axis_2_lane: no amendment-chain depth, cadence or process conditioner exists here; no corrected-value object exists here.
novelty_declaration.generic_mechanisms: ordinary momentum: PASS (returns never ranked). PEAD: no earnings surprise input. Net-share-issuance (Pontiff-Woodgate lineage) is the literature family itself, expressed in a PIT vintage-stamped form the literature has never had for a death-inclusive cohort.
novelty_declaration.blocked_channels: PASS: staged sha-pinned SEC panel + owner-entitled EODHD prices only; no new vendor leg, no keyed fetch, no signup.
novelty_declaration.rescue_variant_check: no parameter, universe, sign or name variant of any forbidden family; a sign-flip of any rejected cell is not proposed; the long-only neighbour is a declared asymmetry diagnostic, not a hedged re-entry of anything vetoed.

literature: Scholes (1972), 'The Market for Securities: Substitution versus Price Pressure and the Effects of Information on Share Prices', Journal of Business 45(2) - downward-sloping demand; supply must be absorbed at a discount
Shleifer (1986), 'Do Demand Curves for Stocks Slope Down?', Journal of Finance 41(3) - price pressure of indexed/supply events and its persistence
Baker & Wurgler (2000), 'The Equity Share in New Issues and Aggregate Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 55(5) - managerial market timing: issuance predicts low returns
Pontiff & Woodgate (2008), 'Share Issuance and Cross-Sectional Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 63(2) - the canonical net-share-issuance anomaly on CRSP share supply
Fama & French (2008), 'Dissecting Anomalies', Journal of Finance 63(4) - net share issuance among the robust cross-sectional predictors, incl. small/micro caps
McLean, Pontiff & Watanabe (2009), 'Share Issuance and Cross-Sectional Returns: International Evidence', Journal of Financial Economics 94(1) - the anomaly's breadth and decay structure

Schultz (2003), 'Pseudo Market Timing and Reliable Long-Run Return Performance', or Loughran & Ritter (1995), 'The New Issues Puzzle', Journal of Finance 50(1) - the new-issue underperformance lineage
